query: Adelaide Australia taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: In South Australia, the starting price (base fare/flagfall) of a taxi is 4.8 AUD, and each kilometre is priced at 2.4 AUD. A 5km ride in South Australia costs about 16.8 AUD with a taxi.

query: Adelaide Australia taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: For UberX in Adelaide, the per-km rate is 1.45 AUD, plus a base fare, per-minute charge, and booking fee on every trip. The minimum fare is 7.00 AUD.
